luke.description: The Luke instance attached to this component.

parentSelector.description: The selector for the connector form

spinner.description: The spinner that masks the component when data is loading

renderingSelectors.description:
An array of selectors used to determine whether the page/component exist or is rendered.  These selectors will be searched
for within the {@link #parentSelector}.

timeout.description: The maximum amount of time that Luke will retry an action

fieldHelperMapping.description: Mappings of field types to their helper types

secondaryGroupSelector.description: Selector for an item inside a form section

fieldGroupSelector.description: Selector for the element that represents a SDLFieldGroup

fieldGroupItemSelector.description:
Selector for the parent element that wraps a field input when it is
nested in a SDLFieldGroup

formGroupEl.description: Selector for a form group element

formGroupDisabledEl.description: Selector for a disabled form group element

formGroupErrorEl.description: Selector for the form group error element

formFieldHintEl.description: Selector for the form field hint element

formFieldEl.description: Selector for the form field element

progressStep.description: Selector for a single step of the progress steps

testConnectionButtonSelector.description:
The CSS selector for the "Test Connection" button in the SelfServiceDI multi-step component.
This selector is used to identify the "Test Connection" button in the DOM.

testConnectionStatusSelector.description: The CSS selector to get the "Test Connection" status.

bucketUrlDropDownSelector.description: Selector to click and open the dropdown options for bucket url.

bucketUrlDropDownInputSelector.description: Selector to set the input value of the bucket url.

bucketUrlDropDownInputOption1Selector.description: Selector to select 1st option from dropdown for the bucket url.

bucketUrlDropDownInputOptionSelector.description: Selector to select an option from dropdown for the bucket url.

bucketUrlDropdownClearSelector.description: Selector to clear the selected option for the bucket url.
